WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    AlbumId,
    CASE 
      WHEN SUM(Bytes) IS NULL OR SUM(Milliseconds) IS NULL OR SUM(Milliseconds) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds)
    END AS ratio,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.ratio,
    s1.cnt,
    s1.ratio - s2.avg_ratio AS diff
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s1.ratio IS NOT NULL AND s2.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s1.ratio > s2.avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio,
  AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt,
  AVG(diff) AS avg_diff
FROM step3
